synthetic_lowbit_hdr_dr10.description: Low-bit weak/strong off-grid spike recovery at 10x dynamic range, matching the Fig. 2 regime with K=2, amplitude ratio 10, N=501, and 3-bit modulo sensing. The paper reports at least 30 dB MSE gain over conventional sampling across these dynamic-range and bit-depth settings.

mse_gain_over_conventional_db.description: Primary benefit metric: reconstruction MSE improvement over the clipped conventional sparse-recovery baseline.

psnr_db.description: Signal-quality benefit metric that rewards high-fidelity waveform reconstruction.

time_mae_samples.description: Localization error averaged over both recovered off-grid spike times.

weak_tau_mae_samples.description: Localization error on the later weak reflection, preventing scores from hiding weak-target failures behind the strong peak.

tau_max_error_samples.description: Average worst spike-time error per trial, catching methods that recover only one of the two reflections well.

signal_mse.description: Absolute waveform reconstruction error, included to anchor gains to the underlying signal estimate.

hard_fold_signal_mse.description: Waveform MSE restricted to sample positions whose clean signal exceeds the modulo range, stressing genuinely folded high-dynamic-range regions.

wrapped_measurement_mae.description: Sensor-consistency constraint: the reconstructed waveform should wrap back to the observed modulo measurements.

dynamic_range_x.description: Configuration check confirming the advertised high-dynamic-range stress level is preserved.

quant_bits.description: Configuration check confirming the low-bit sensing budget is not increased.

amplitude_ratio.description: Configuration check confirming the weak/strong reflection amplitude disparity is preserved.

mean_fold_count.description: Configuration check confirming the slice contains actual modulo folding events.
